meta.title: Spider Solitaire
meta.description: Plays classic Spider Solitaire in the right Sidebar: one, two or four suits, five stock deals, undo and redo, hints, and Microsoft-style scoring. The running game and each difficulty's statistics stay in this browser's local storage. Open it from the Spade button at the sidebar foot or from the Sidebar guide.
